item.text: I’ll build a shaft with a helical flight, then compare the four views to refine its proportions and orientation.

arguments.code:
shaft = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(10).extrude(70)
helix = cq.Wire.makeHelix(8,40,13)
flight = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(9.5,-1),(16,-1),(16,1),(9.5,1)]).close().sweep(cq.Workplane(obj=helix),isFrenet=True)
flight = flight.translate((0,0,15))
result = shaft.union(flight)
arguments.label: Helical flight and cylindrical shaft

item.text: The first model is a valid single solid and has the main proportions in place. I’m refining the flight spacing and end positions against the reference. You can follow the model in the [CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8771/#part.FCStd).
